properties.summary: Illustrative massing: each zone is drawn to its maximum height under the 2025 Master Community Plan Scheme C Supplement, not as a building design. The light-industrial Parcels 1 and 2 rise to 90 ft over a 60-ft base (up to half the buildings may exceed 60 ft); the City Center blocks of Parcels 4 and 5 rise to the project's 190-ft (17-story) cap, though the plan expects 10-12-story towers on low podiums. The city park (Parcel 3) and the retention pond are not massing; nothing has been built.
properties.note: Parcels and blocks are drawn to their height limits in the 2025 master plan, not as building designs; real buildings will be lower over most of each block.

properties.label: Parcels 1 and 2
properties.source: illustrative: parcels outlined from Master Community Plan Scheme C Supplement (Santa Clara Resolution 25-9467, July 8, 2025), Exhibit 4C-1 (Scheme C), Parcel & Block Key Plan, p. 54, without the retention pond (the exhibit's note: not part of the development area); drawn to 90 ft over a 60-ft base from the Parcel 1 and 2 building heights, pp. 55 and 57 ("roughly one to two high ceiling levels, or 60'. Up to 50% of buildings may reach a height of up to 90'")
properties.note: Light industrial campuses. Up to half of the buildings may rise above 60 ft, to 90 ft. The city's retention pond is left out.
